name: Naneun Pyeongsaeng Geunyeowa Hamkkehanda.
source: Kang Min-woo, an outsider who doesn't have a career path or dreams and lacks academic enthusiasm, but loves reading. The popular insider Yang Se-eun keeps approaching Min-woo with her cool personality and beauty...
translation: 姜珉宇是一个没有职业道路、没有梦想、缺乏学术热情、却热爱读书的局外人。人气圈内人杨世恩以冷酷的性格和美丽不断接近珉宇……
